answer_records.q: What documents do I need for KYC?
answer_records.reply: For Smart KYC you’ll need your GST certificate, Udyam (MSME) certificate, a recent address proof (like a utility bill) and the ID of the authorised signatory (PAN or Aadhaar). Partnerships, LLPs or companies also need an authorisation letter or board resolution.

answer_records.q: Can I do KYC without uploading photos?
answer_records.reply: Yes, you can complete KYC using DigiLocker and Aadhaar OTP without uploading photos. The system will fetch your GST and other documents from DigiLocker and verify you with an OTP.

answer_records.q: How long does installation take?
answer_records.reply: Installation time depends on the products you choose. Fibre takes about 5 days, 5G AirFiber about 2 days, a mobile line 1 day, and a leased line 21‑30 days. Your whole bundle will be live when the slowest product is installed.

answer_records.q: Is the price shown with GST or without?
What is the difference between a 12 and 24 month contract?
answer_records.reply: A 24-month contract gets the lowest catalogue price for each product. The services themselves are the same on both, only your commitment changes.

answer_records.q: Can I change my bundle after I see the quote?
answer_records.reply: Yes, add-ons can be switched on or off, quantities changed, and the contract length switched at any time before ordering, on the quote screen or by asking the advisor.

answer_records.q: What are the steps after I accept the quote?
answer_records.reply: After you accept the quote, the process is: we do Smart KYC (DigiLocker/Aadhaar OTP), you e‑sign the agreement, we verify the details, schedule installation, and you receive WhatsApp updates at each step until the service goes live.

answer_records.q: Which products need a GSTIN?
answer_records.reply: GSTIN is needed for WhatsApp Business API, bulk SMS, toll-free numbers, cloud telephony, managed SD-WAN, managed firewall, machine monitoring, both leased lines, and the 1 Gbps fibre plan. Other products like internet, mobile, CCTV, POS billing, email, security, and backup do not require a GSTIN.

answer_records.q: Is 1 Gbps fibre available in my small town?
answer_records.reply: Biz Fibre 1G is available only in tier-1 cities [product#, eligibility#city-tier]. Since your city is Jaipur, we can check alternative broadband plans like 300 Mbps fibre or 5G AirFiber for your site.

answer_records.q: Can a 5 person shop get a leased line?
answer_records.reply: Internet Leased Line 20 needs 10 or more staff, so a 5 person shop is not eligible for it [product#, eligibility#team-size-and-locations]. You can choose our business fibre broadband options instead, such as Biz Fibre 100 or Biz Fibre 300.

answer_records.q: Can I buy a static IP without an internet connection?
answer_records.reply: No, a Static IP requires an internet line in the same bundle. You can easily add an internet line to your bundle.

answer_records.q: Who books the technician visit?
answer_records.reply: You pick the technician's slot yourself in the order tracker, no phone call needed.

answer_records.q: How do I raise a complaint after installation?
answer_records.reply: You can raise a ticket directly from the order tracker in the app, and a local Accel partner who speaks your language will call you back on request.

answer_records.q: What if fibre is not available at my shop?
answer_records.reply: If fibre isn’t available at your shop, we can provide our Biz 5G AirFiber 100 – a wireless 5G broadband solution that’s plug‑and‑play and needs no cable. It delivers up to 100 Mbps and is priced like any other broadband plan.

answer_records.q: How should I take photos of my documents?
answer_records.reply: Take each photo in good light, flat, with all four corners visible and no glare. If a photo is too blurred to read, the app says so straight away and asks for a new photo.

answer_records.q: What checks do you run on my documents?
answer_records.reply: Each document is checked against the GST and Udyam registries and against the other documents, including the GSTIN format, active status, legal name, state code, Udyam number, address proof date, and signatory ID.

answer_records.q: My GST certificate was rejected, what now?
answer_records.reply: If your GST certificate was rejected, you will see exactly which document failed and why, so you can fix only that document and verify again. A business without a GSTIN can still complete KYC for products that do not need a GSTIN.

answer_records.q: Do you read my documents before I agree?
answer_records.reply: Your documents are used only to verify your business and signatory. Photos are deleted right after details are read, and only a secure hash is kept. ID numbers are masked on screen and in audit logs.

answer_records.q: Do you keep the photos of my documents?
answer_records.reply: We only keep a fingerprint (hash) of each document for verification and delete the photos right after reading them, so your documents are not stored.

answer_records.q: Can I delete my data?
answer_records.reply: Yes, you can see what was collected and erase your data before placing an order.

answer_records.q: Does the AI see my Aadhaar card?
answer_records.reply: No, the AI never sees document images. It only gets the business details you typed.

answer_records.q: Is there a one-time setup fee?
answer_records.reply: Every bundle has one monthly price for all services on one bill, shown before 18% GST, plus a one-time setup fee for some products. The setup fee also carries 18% GST, so the first bill is the monthly price plus the setup fee, plus GST on both.

answer_records.q: Can I see the status of my order?
answer_records.reply: The tracker shows every service's status and expected date. You can also pick the technician's slot yourself in the order tracker, and a local Accel partner who speaks your language can call back on request.

answer_records.q: How fast is Biz Fibre 300?
answer_records.reply: Biz Fibre 300 offers business fibre broadband with 300 Mbps speed, unlimited data, and optional static IP.

answer_records.q: What does the toll-free number cost?
answer_records.reply: Toll-free Number costs Rs 1500 to Rs 2000 a month per number with a setup fee of Rs 1000 and a minimum contract of 12 months, subject to having an active GSTIN.

answer_records.q: Tell me about the WhatsApp Business API
answer_records.reply: WhatsApp Business API Starter gives you a verified WhatsApp channel with catalogue support and up to 1,000 conversations a month. It costs Rs 999‑1499 per month per account (setup fee Rs 0), requires a minimum 3‑month contract and an active GSTIN. Installation typically takes about 3 days.

answer_records.q: How many SMS do I get in the SMS pack?
answer_records.reply: You get 10,000 SMS per month with our Business SMS 10k pack, and we assist with DLT registration. It costs between Rs 1500 and Rs 2000 a month and requires an active GSTIN.

answer_records.q: What is managed SD-WAN?
answer_records.reply: Managed SD-WAN is a connectivity service that offers central management of links across sites and app-priority routing. It costs between Rs 2500 and Rs 3500 a month per site with a setup fee of Rs 5000, requires a minimum contract of 24 months, and takes about 14 days to install. It needs 10 or more staff, 3 or more sites, an active GSTIN, and an internet line in the same bundle.

answer_records.q: How much cloud backup storage do I get?
answer_records.reply: You get 1 TB of automatic backup for your PCs and phones with Cloud Backup 1 TB.

answer_records.q: Does the website plan include a domain?
answer_records.reply: Yes, the Website + Domain Starter includes both the domain and a 5-page website builder with hosting and SSL.

answer_records.q: How many days of recording does the CCTV keep?
answer_records.reply: Cloud CCTV keeps 30 days of HD recording with mobile app view.

answer_records.q: What is in the business postpaid 599 plan?
answer_records.reply: Business Postpaid 599 includes a dedicated business mobile line with 150 GB of high‑speed data per month, unlimited voice calls, roaming capability, and priority customer care. The monthly price ranges from Rs 599 to Rs 799 per line, with zero setup fee and a minimum contract of 1 month.

answer_records.q: Is antivirus available for my shop PCs?
answer_records.reply: Yes, Endpoint Security provides antivirus and ransomware protection for PCs and phones, starting from Rs 99 to Rs 149 a month per device with a 12-month minimum contract.

answer_records.q: What does the managed firewall do?
answer_records.reply: A managed firewall provides advanced security for your network by monitoring traffic and blocking cyber threats like ransomware. It is managed by our security team to keep your business data safe. You need at least 10 staff and a GSTIN to add this to your bundle.

answer_records.q: Do you have GPS trackers for my delivery vans?
Can I monitor my factory machines?
answer_records.reply: Yes, we offer Machine Monitoring IoT that tracks machine uptime and energy use with a sensor kit and SIM. It needs an active GSTIN and at least 10 staff in your business.

answer_records.q: What is the SLA on the 100 Mbps leased line?
Do you have business email on my own domain?
Can I take card payments on a tablet?
Do you offer IVR and call recording?
What is the price of Biz Fibre 100?
My internet keeps dropping in the evening, what can keep me online?
Someone stole from my shop last month, what can help?
Customers keep asking for the wifi password
I want customers to reach me on chat with my product list
All my accounts are on one old computer, I'm scared of losing them
I miss calls when my staff are busy with customers
I can't see what is happening at my other branches
When will the engineer come to fit the line?
Do I have to visit an office with paper forms?
Is my personal information safe with you?
I don't have a registered business number, can I still buy?
There is no cable connection in my area
answer_records.reply: Since fibre isn’t available at your location, we can offer our Biz 5G AirFiber 100 solution – a plug‑and‑play 5G broadband that works without any cable. It’s ideal for sites without fibre.

answer_records.q: KYC ke liye kaun se documents chahiye?
Installation mein kitne din lagenge?
answer_records.reply: Installation ka samay har product ke hisaab se alag hota hai, jaise fibre mein lagbhag 5 din aur fleet tracker mein 3 din lagte hain. Jab aap order place karenge, toh aap khud apne technician ka slot tracker mein select kar sakte hain.

answer_records.q: Dukaan mein chori hoti hai, camera chahiye
answer_records.reply: Cloud CCTV camera adds HD recording with 30-day cloud backup and mobile app view. Setup fee is Rs 1800 with a 12-month minimum contract, and it requires an internet line in the bundle.

answer_records.q: Price mein GST shamil hai kya?
Mere paas GST number nahi hai, kya main le sakta hoon?
answer_records.reply: Bina GSTIN ke bhi aap internet, mobile, CCTV, POS billing, email, security aur backup le sakte hain. GST-only products aap baad mein add kar sakte hain.

answer_records.q: Internet band ho jata hai, backup chahiye
केवाईसी के लिए कौन से दस्तावेज़ चाहिए?
answer_records.reply: केवाईसी के लिए चार मुख्य दस्तावेज़ चाहिए: जीएसटी प्रमाणपत्र, उद्यम प्रमाणपत्र, पिछले 90 दिनों के भीतर का पता प्रमाण (जैसे बिजली, पानी या फोन बिल), और अधिकृत हस्ताक्षरकर्ता का पैन या आधार।

answer_records.q: इंस्टॉलेशन में कितने दिन लगेंगे?
answer_records.reply: हर प्रोडक्ट का इंस्टॉलेशन समय अलग होता है, जैसे फाइबर में लगभग 5 दिन और मोबाइल लाइन्स में 1 दिन लगता है। पूरा बंडल तब लाइव होता है जब उसका सबसे धीमा प्रोडक्ट इंस्टॉल हो जाता है।

answer_records.q: दुकान के लिए कैमरा चाहिए
क्या मेरा डेटा सुरक्षित है?
answer_records.reply: Your documents are used only to verify your business, and are deleted right after verification while a secure cryptographic hash is kept. ID numbers are masked on screen and in audit logs to ensure your data remains protected.

answer_records.q: इंटरनेट बंद हो जाए तो क्या होगा?
answer_records.reply: अगर आपका मुख्य इंटरनेट लिंक बंद हो जाता है तो बैकअप 4G/5G फेलओवर राउटर स्वचालित रूप से डेटा SIM पर स्विच कर देगा, जिससे कनेक्शन जारी रहेगा।

answer_records.q: 12 और 24 महीने में क्या फर्क है?
केवायसीसाठी कोणती कागदपत्रे लागतात?
answer_records.reply: केवायसीसाठी मुख्यत्वे चार कागदपत्रे लागतात: जीएसटी प्रमाणपत्र, उद्यम प्रमाणपत्र, गेल्या ९० दिवसांमधील पत्त्याचा पुरावा (उदा. वीज किंवा पाणी बिल) आणि अधिकृत सही करणाऱ्या व्यक्तीची ओळख (पॅन किंवा आधार). भागीदारी संस्था किंवा कंपन्यांसाठी बोर्ड रेझोल्यूशन किंवा AUTHORISATION लेटर देखील आवश्यक असते.

answer_records.q: दुकानासाठी सीसीटीव्ही कॅमेरा हवा आहे
KYC க்கு என்ன ஆவணங்கள் தேவை?
answer_records.reply: Smart KYC-க்கு GST சான்றிதழ், உத்யாம் (MSME) சான்றிதழ், கடந்த 90 நாட்களுக்குள் பெறப்பட்ட முகவரி சான்று மற்றும் அதிகாரம் பெற்றவரின் PAN அல்லது Aadhaar போன்ற ஐடி தேவைப்படும்.

answer_records.q: கடைக்கு கேமரா வேண்டும்
நிறுவல் எத்தனை நாட்கள் ஆகும்?
answer_records.reply: நிறுவல் பொதுவாக சில நாட்களுக்குள் முடிக்கப்படும். உள்ளூர் பங்குதாரர் உங்களைத் தொடர்பு கொண்டு நேரத்தை உறுதி செய்வார்.

answer_records.q: দোকানের জন্য সিসিটিভি ক্যামেরা চাই
কেওয়াইসির জন্য কী কী কাগজ লাগবে?
answer_records.reply: কেওয়াইসির জন্য কোনো কাগজের প্রয়োজন নেই। আপনি ডিজিটলাকার (DigiLocker) বা আধার ওটিপি (Aadhaar OTP) অথবা ছবি আপলোড করে খুব সহজেই স্মার্ট কেওয়াইসি সম্পন্ন করতে পারবেন।

answer_records.q: షాపుకి సీసీటీవీ కెమెరా కావాలి
દુકાન માટે સીસીટીવી કેમેરા જોઈએ છે
ಅಂಗಡಿಗೆ ಸಿಸಿಟಿವಿ ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾ ಬೇಕು
കടയ്ക്ക് സിസിടിവി ക്യാമറ വേണം
answer_records.reply: തീർച്ചയായും, നിങ്ങളുടെ ഫാർമസിയിലേക്ക് സിസിടിവി ക്യാമറകൾ ഉൾപ്പെടുത്താം. എത്ര ക്യാമറകളാണ് നിങ്ങൾക്ക് ആവശ്യമുള്ളതെന്ന് പറയാമോ?

answer_records.q: ਦੁਕਾਨ ਲਈ ਸੀਸੀਟੀਵੀ ਕੈਮਰਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ
answer_records.reply: ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਫਾਰਮੇਸੀ ਲਈ ਸੀਸੀਟੀਵੀ ਕੈਮਰੇ ਸਾਡੇ ਕੋਲ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹਨ। ਮੈਂ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਬੰਡਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੋੜ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ।

answer_records.q: Who won the cricket match yesterday?
answer_records.reply: I’m sorry, I don’t have that information. Let’s focus on your telecom needs.

answer_records.q: Can you give me a loan for my shop?
answer_records.reply: Sorry, we only provide telecom and digital services, not loans. Let me know if you need any connectivity or business solutions for your pharmacy.

answer_records.q: Do you offer a free iPhone with the plan?
What is the GST rate on medicines?
answer_records.reply: I am an Accel business advisor for your telecom and digital services. I can help you with internet, billing, and security for your pharmacy, but I do not have information on medicine tax rates. Would you like to proceed with your business bundle setup?

answer_records.q: Mujhe accountant chahiye GST return file karne ke liye
answer_records.reply: क्षमा कीजिए, हम केवल टेलीकॉम और डिजिटल सेवाएँ प्रदान करते हैं। आप किसी स्थानीय अकाउंटेंट से संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

answer_records.q: Can you install solar panels on my roof?
answer_records.reply: I am sorry, but Accel only provides digital and telecom business solutions. We do not offer solar panel installation services.
